tagline: Protecting what matters. Enabling confidence through integrated insurance and technology solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: Strategic lever for acquisitions, dividends, and financial resilience within an integrated insurance-tech model. Key driver of capex flexibility and shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Holding Company Liquidity
kpis.explanation: Cash available at the holding company to fund acquisitions, dividends, or share repurchases.
kpis.description: Liquidity available at Assurant, Inc. (holding company) after safety reserve. Used for buybacks, dividends, acquisitions.
kpis.signal: High level of strategic liquidity well above minimum.

kpis.name: Dividends from Subsidiaries
kpis.explanation: Net cash flows received by the holding company from insurance subsidiaries.
kpis.description: Net dividends received by the holding company from insurance subsidiaries, essential to fund shareholder return policies and corporate expenses.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in cash flows from subsidiaries.

kpis.name: Stock Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount spent to repurchase outstanding shares, reducing share count.
kpis.description: Share repurchases executed during 2025 (1,432,302 shares at $299.9M), under the authorized repurchase program.
kpis.signal: Acceleration of buybacks despite higher dividend.

kpis.name: Dividend Paid
kpis.explanation: Total amount of dividends paid to common shareholders during the year.
kpis.description: Dividends paid to shareholders, with a 10% increase to $0.88 per share quarterly in Q4 2025.
kpis.signal: 10% increase in quarterly dividend demonstrating confidence in cash flow generation.

kpis.name: Share Repurchase Authorization
kpis.explanation: Total amount authorized by the board to repurchase shares in future periods.
kpis.description: New $700 million authorization in November 2025, in addition to the remaining $600 million from prior authorization.
kpis.signal: New $700M authorization in November 2025 reinforcing commitment to shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount of annual dividend paid per common share.
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share following increase to $0.88 per quarter by end of 2025 (10% increase).
kpis.signal: Notable increase in dividend per share reflecting improved profitability.

kpis.name: Dividend Increase
kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in the quarterly dividend upon Q4 2025 announcement.
kpis.description: Quarterly dividend increased from $0.80 to $0.88 in Q4 2025, a 10% increase.
kpis.signal: Increase from $0.80 to $0.88 per share quarterly signaling confidence in cash flow generation.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the 8 most recent fiscal years reported (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $12.814 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the 8 most recent fiscal years reported (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.873 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Financial and investment portfolio risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's investment portfolio is exposed to credit, liquidity, and other risks that could negatively affect operating results and financial condition, as noted in Item 1A of the Risk Factors.

risks.title: Internal control risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has assessed the effectiveness of its internal controls under COSO criteria, but there is a risk that controls may become inadequate due to changes or that compliance may deteriorate.

risks.title: Reputation risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risks related to the quality of its products and services, as well as customer and public perception, as mentioned in Item 1A of the Risk Factors.

risks.title: Governance and compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has established governance policies and procedures, but there is a risk they may not be sufficiently effective to prevent or detect irregularities.

risks.title: Litigation risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risks related to legal proceedings or claims from customers or employees, as noted in Item 1A of the Risk Factors.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence in the provided 10-K.
